identity.name: RATHI STEEL & POWER LTD.
identity.industry: Stainless Steel & TMT Bar Manufacturing with Circular Economy Focus

summary.oneLiner: Rathi Steel has restarted its TMT mill and achieved 40-50% utilization, improving QoQ revenue by 27%, while advancing green steel certification and direct billet charging to reduce costs; what matters is the imminent potential for margin expansion once backward integration of TMT is completed and green certifications are secured.

one-line thesis: Rathi Steel has restarted its TMT mill and achieved 40-50% utilization, improving QoQ revenue by 27%, while advancing green steel certification and direct billet charging to reduce costs; what matters is the imminent potential for margin expansion once backward integration of TMT is completed and green certifications are secured.
financial scorecard: revenue: INR156.4cr (Q2FY26) +27% YoY; EBITDA/margin: INR6.37cr / 4% (flat YoY, distorted by TMT ramp-up costs); PAT (rptd): not disclosed; PAT (normalized): not disclosed; order book: not disclosed; net debt: INR120cr (18% cost of debt, refinancing to 16% in progress)
guidance: revenue growth: 20% CAGR over next 2 years; margin: improving via backward integration and direct charging; order inflow: not specified; capex/commissioning: INR40cr spent last 3 yrs; future capex for TMT integration via internal accruals
segment / subsidiary detail: Stainless steel: 60-65% of H1FY26 revenue, end-to-end, higher margins; TMT: 30% of H1FY26 revenue, currently converter model, no backward integration, margins low but improving with direct charging pilot
growth verticals / optionality: Green steel certification for institutional tenders; potential entry into allied construction products via Rathi brand distribution; replication of direct charging model to TMT mill
margins & cost dynamics: EBITDA margin stuck at ~4% due to TMT ramp-up costs and pricing pressure; direct billet charging reduced fuel costs by ~0.5% scale loss and lowered carbon footprint; power cost increased slightly; net savings positive; cost structure tight, no major capex planned for expansion
capex / expansion: INR40cr spent over last 3 years; current capex for TMT direct charging replication funded internally; rooftop solar feasibility study ongoing; no capacity expansion beyond 85ktpa melting or 2ltpa rolling planned yet
capital allocation: Prioritizing internal accruals for balancing capex; no equity infusion planned; debt refinancing underway to reduce cost from 18% to 16%; no dividends or buybacks mentioned
risks & watch-items: High cost of debt (18%); pricing pressure from imports and IBC-acquired competitors; NCR construction seasonality (Q3 soft); pollution compliance risks; green steel certification delay
management quality / tone: Cautiously optimistic; focused on asset utilization, margin improvement via integration, and green transition; transparent on challenges; avoids overpromising on numbers
non-obvious takeaways: Rathi brand license (owned by promoter family) has zero material royalty cost (INR500/yr), enabling low-cost retail distribution for TMT and future stainless rebars; this is a hidden moat
